title: the Undercroft Rising
author: E. M. Quintana
blurb: Ulyana Halloran, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
